messages:
viv: Heads-up: planning a selective unpin tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Goal: bump hosted runtime 3.0 -> 3.1 but keep embeddings pinned for compatibility with older SDKs. Need a short escape-hatch and release blurb.

martin: Which routes are in/out?

viv: Plan: unpin generate/chat, keep /v1/embed and /v1/rerank pinned to 3.0 for 72h. Account-level opt-in pin available for Dedicated.

claire: Quantized models note: quant-v3 hostnames must stay on 3.0 else kernel mismatch. I'll add hostname pins.

deploybot: Change window scheduled at 1733337200 (02:00 UTC). Canary cohort can-31-01 at 5% for 20m. Roll: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds.

ops-bot: Rollback criteria: error >1% for 5m OR embedding-quality-regression alert. Will auto-apply sticky-pins on regressions.

sdk-team: We're shipping a small header to report client sdk_version; will help correlate issues. ETA is tonight.

viv: Decision summary: unpin generate/chat to 3.1; keep embed/rerank pinned to 3.0 for 72h; hostname pins for quant-v3 applied; ops sticky-pin on alerts.

deploybot: Canary started. Metrics after 15m: errors 0.25%, p95 +9%; embed routes unchanged.

martin: Longseq p95 uptick noted on chat for seq>2048. Can we enable the longseq mitigation flag on canary?

viv: Enabled longseq_tune on canary. Re-run for 20m.

deploybot: Re-run metrics: errors 0.18%, longseq p95 +11%.

claire: Ok to proceed to 25%. Support note drafted explaining embed pin and opt-in for Dedicated.

ops-bot: Sticky-pin thresholds set: error>0.8% OR eval-quality alert. Will post to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: 25% hold metrics steady. Scheduling full ramp in 3h if unchanged.

viv: Filed INF-7001 (e2e embedding-diff test) and INF-7002 (telemetry: sdk_version tag). Assigning to infra and eng-ml.

martin: Thanks. I'll keep an eye on canary dashboards.

viv: Closing coordination thread; will update release notes after final ramp.
